You'd  be  amazed  at  how  much  better  you 
 get  after  you've  done  it  a  hundred 
 times.  If  you  want  to  win,  do  it  again. 
 You  don't  just  post  a  hundred  videos  in 
 a  row  and  see  what  happens.  You  post 
 one,  see  what  worked,  and  then  try  and 
 do  more  of  that  thing.  And  so,  the  idea 
 isn't  just  raw  effort.  It's  raw  effort 
 with  an  improvement  lip.
